name: Arequipa
summary: Add Arequipa for sillar architecture, distinctive food and the Colca region. The canyon deserves an overnight excursion rather than being squeezed into a city afternoon.
seasonNote: Generally dry conditions favour walks; high passes and canyon excursions remain cold at night.
arrival: Fly to AQP, then use an authorized taxi into the historic centre.
gettingAround: Walk the central grid; arrange a reputable tour or driver for Colca.
cashTip: Bring smaller soles notes for local meals; carry backup cash for rural excursions.
foodTip: Try rocoto relleno, chupe de camarones or vegetarian regional dishes at a picantería.
buyTip: Shop for clearly labelled alpaca garments and local craft; inspect stitching and fibre content.
baseArea: Around Plaza de Armas or Yanahuara.

connections.note: Direct service may be limited; check schedule before arranging the loop.

reviewSummary: Santa Catalina has thousands of visitor reviews and is a recurrent highlight in indexed feedback; the listing describes it as a substantial city-within-a-city visit.

items.tip: Wildlife is never guaranteed. Confirm tourist ticket, transport, meals and accommodation inclusions.

items.name: Ruta del Sillar · Añashuayco quarries
items.summary: See where the pale volcanic building stone of Arequipa is quarried and carved.
items.expect: Dust, bright sun and uneven ground; transport or tours are extra.
items.tip: Check the official page before setting out.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate in local currency; confirm the current price and what is included.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Quarry walls explain the material that gives Arequipa its white-stone architecture.
Stoneworkers and carved surfaces connect city monuments with the labour behind them.
visitFlow: Arrange a quarry visit and return transport.
Walk the designated quarry area and watch a carving demonstration if offered.
items.tradeoffs: A working landscape with limited shade; tours vary in scope.

dayClusters.label: A first day in the White City
dayClusters.note: Group the central plaza, monastery and working market. Check monastery hours and keep a midday break; all are within the historic-city area.

dayClusters.label: Colca Valley overnight excursion
dayClusters.note: Two days and one night are reserved for the canyon trip, including the long road journey and high passes. The second day is a continuation, not a new city-sightseeing day. Confirm accommodation, tourist ticket, meals and transfers in the quote.

dayClusters.label: Additional city museums and crafts
dayClusters.note: An extra Arequipa day or an alternative if you omit Colca. Visit the museum and textile shops, then take a short transfer to Yanahuara for the view.
